Bhopal RTO Officer Murdered; Inter-caste Marriage, Boyfriend Cited

Meenakshi, an RTO officer in Bhopal, was murdered. Reports suggest her inter-caste marriage was a cause for the murder, with her being entangled with her family and boyfriend. A friend, who was sleeping in a separate room, revealed details of the incident. The victim's boyfriend reportedly traveled 609 km to meet her.
